reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread. I didn't record the deadline as settled, because there's a problem with the date.

- **The date doesn't fit:** today is 14 Oct 2026, so "6 June" has either already passed (if it's 2026) or is about eight months away (if it's 2027).
- **No record of Halyard:** I checked #central-team and the public team files and found nothing on a Halyard rollout or its deadline. I didn't use `search_messages` or read anywhere Hollis can't see.
- **The last Marrow thread looks unfinished:** on 9 June the team was still working on Marrow Agrisupply's slow store rollout. That covered ticket PD-4821 for the Eastbank door import and the missing morning shift at Pine Crossing. Nothing later in the channel says it was finished.

I asked Hollis which year he means and whether Halyard has already gone live. I said I'll do nothing until he answers.
